title: runtime: resolveArtifactCollections keeps the first of two bodies' namespace-scoped items of one name and drops the rest; key them by (package, name) or refuse (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg5AUtn9pwa3g2bBqk

④ coordination card: a child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527.

**Epic:** ADR-0150 (#31527). **Lane:** `domain:server` (runtime artifact collections). **Reader:** the server seat that claims it.
**Found by** the #32245 dev (PR #32333, out-of-scope flag) and confirmed by the epic seat's red-line read of PR #32333 at `22b11016` (record 6779348331). Drafted by the epic seat (epic:#31527#1); filed by server seat 1.

### A first-wins pick in the resolved collections

`mergeCollection` claims items by identity or by name (`claimedIdentities` / `itemIdentity`), and the record form keeps the first key. So when two bodies of one artifact each hold a namespace-scoped item of one name (which ADR-0150 admits for `agent`, `skill`, object-less `action` and `email_template` once each family narrows), the second body's item is silently dropped from the resolved collections: a first-wins pick (red line 2). #32333 reads the bodies directly for actions to avoid this; every other reader of the resolved collections still gets the pick.

**Do:**
1. For the types in core's `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, keep each body's item and carry its declaring package, or refuse the artifact naming both bodies. Never keep one at random.
2. Pin: two bodies of two namespaces each declaring agent `helper`: both survive with their package, or the load refuses naming both. CONTROL: a one-body artifact and a non-scoped family unchanged. Ablate once.

**Clause-②:** the seat declares it (widening if both survive; narrowing with FROM → TO and census if the load refuses).
**Business reason:** without this, a composed artifact silently loses one package's agent, skill, action or template of a shared name.
**Epic red-line review before landing.**

**Dedupe** (open, `resolveArtifactCollections`, `mergeCollection first wins`): none found.
